packages.name: Reclaim
packages.notes:
0.1.1-1572
- System partition cleanup offers Standard and Deep modes; Deep previews each item's effect and asks for an extra confirmation.
- The system partition warning starts at 900 MB free, and Settings can turn it off; cleanup stays on the Overview card.
- Pages, dialogs and buttons follow the DSM look of UI 0.10.
- Built on SDK 0.12.1: an administrator approves Syno Reclaim again after the upgrade.

packages.name: Connect
packages.notes:
0.1.0-0053
- Buttons, dialogs, scrollbars and corners follow DSM: page and form actions are pill-shaped buttons, toolbar buttons are grey, and dialogs size to their content.
- Each page spaces its sections like DSM.
- Stopping a connection uses the same button as the actions under it.
- Upgrading from 0.1.0-0052 needs no administrator approval.
